series.title: Chained to My Nemesis
series.description: Spoiled heir Shane is handcuffed to his childhood victim Tessa for one week. Pass the test, get the inheritance. Fail, and his ruthless uncle wins everything, including the right to ruin them both.

series.title: Dear Stranger, I Love You
series.description: Mia runs a secret essay app. When jock Brad discovers her identity, he blackmails her into writing love letters. But as feelings blur and secrets spread, Mia risks losing everything, including her heart.

series.title: Falling for the Man I Destroyed
series.description: Alexander Knight, a shadowy businessman, draws journalist Anne Sinclair into his world of blurred morality. Betrayed by Max, a vengeful informant, Alexander falls as Anne battles her love and her integrity.

series.title: He Ruined Me… Now I Have to Save Him
series.description: Spy Brielle swore never to work for the Browns, the family she blames for her father's death. But when she's forced to protect heir Ethan Brown, secrets unravel, and an unexpected bond forms.

series.title: Lessons in Love and Hate
series.description: When unpopular valedictorian Peyton is forced to tutor the school's rich new bad boy, sparks fly. But a jealous queen bee is watching, and one viral moment could destroy them both.

series.title: Mrs. CEO: Strictly Unprofessional
series.description: After her husband's betrayal, a powerful CEO falls for her young, dominant assistant.

series.title: My Handsome Bodyguard
series.description: Lea, the spoiled daughter of one of the world's most feared mafia bosses, loses her father in a tragic plane crash and takes over his empire. Surrounded by enemies, she must trust the one man assigned to keep her alive: her handsome new bodyguard.

series.title: My Knockout Fake Husband
series.description: Senate candidate Nora West fakes a marriage with underground fighter Luke Maddox and his daughter Skye to improve her campaign image. As their arrangement becomes real, secrets threaten everything.

series.title: My Lumberjack Lover Is a Billionaire
series.description: Stranded at a cabin after a car crash, a high-strung CEO falls for the gruff woodsman who saved her, never suspecting he's a billionaire in hiding, or that her job depends on stealing his land.

series.title: Plaything of the Mafia King
series.description: To find her missing sister, a college girl becomes a mafia don's collared plaything, and falls for the dangerous man she came to destroy. She has three weeks before she owes him her body.

series.title: Risky Love with My Boyfriend's Dad
series.description: My boyfriend is a loser, but his father… is a beast. He saved me from a nightmare when my own boyfriend wouldn't even pick up the phone. Now I'm trapped in his house, sleeping in his shirt, and feeling his scorching gaze on my skin. Mr. Burke is a brilliant surgeon by day, but a dangerous man by night. He says I'm too young. He says this is a mistake. But if I'm such a mistake, why does he grip my waist so tight when we're alone?

series.title: Rosy Psycho
series.description: Raised in love and abundance, Gigi Philips grows up as a ray of sunshine, heiress to ROSE, the cosmetics empire her parents James and Laura built. But behind the perfect family and the sweetest smile, something dark is blooming, and nobody sees it coming.

series.title: Sold to the Mafia Queen
series.description: When a struggling waitress is gambled away by her boyfriend at an illegal poker table, she's claimed by the ruthless queen of the underworld, only to discover that the most dangerous woman she's ever met may also be the only one who ever truly saved her.

series.title: Surrender to My Ex's Dad
series.description: On her 22nd birthday, Ellie catches her boyfriend cheating, then falls for his father, a powerful CEO. A scandalous affair turns into forbidden love as secrets, betrayal and passion spiral out of control.

series.title: Tamed by My Dad's Best Friend
series.description: A college girl falls for her father's brooding best friend, the ex-bodyguard who moves in to guard her from a stalker. He swore never to cross the line. She's determined to make him break it.

series.title: The Billionaire I Must Ruin
series.description: Anya infiltrates billionaire Damien's world to destroy him, but falling for him was never part of the plan. As love and revenge collide, she must choose between justice and the man she swore to ruin.

series.title: The Billionaire's Private Dancer
series.description: A stripper takes a billionaire widower's discreet deal to save her grandmother's home: dance nights, an allowance, and one rule: no sex. His patience turns out to be the most dangerous thing of all.

series.title: The Bookworm and the Billionaire
series.description: A romance writer helps her boss date a reclusive billionaire author. Falling for him is forbidden.

series.title: The Dumb Billionaire Heiress in Love: Part II
series.description: Antonio accidentally shoots Isabella, who wakes from a six-month coma with no memory. While Stella impersonates her and secretly drains the family fortune in her name, Isabella must piece her life back together and take back everything that was stolen.

series.title: The Janitor Owns Everything
series.description: Billionaire heir Marcus Hale swaps his tailored suits for a janitor's uniform to expose the corruption rotting his father's empire. The disguise becomes a dangerous trap when he meets Sofie, a bullied secretary who sees the man behind the mop. While office tyrants plot to steal his inheritance and frame him for a crime, Marcus and Sofie launch a high-stakes counterstrike. To save the company, the "invisible" girl must transform into a ruthless CEO. In this world of corporate predators, only one question remains: how far will you go for the one who saw you when no one else did?

series.title: The Phoenix Conspiracy
series.description: A private investigator is pulled into the dangerous web of a covert organization led by an enigmatic figure known as Phoenix. When he falls for a woman married to one of its members, every secret becomes a threat to both their lives.

series.title: The Quarterback's Secret Princess
series.description: A princess goes undercover at a suburban high school for one normal year. A star football player with a hidden camera and secrets of his own threatens to expose everything, starting with her heart.

series.title: The Sound of Us
series.description: After bodyguard Logan saves pop star Mila from a shooter, she falls for the one man she can't have. But when her manager plots to kill her, only his protection and their dangerous love can save her.

series.title: Twisted Fates
series.description: Finch, a hardworking middle-class man, is drawn into a world where love and desire collide. Every choice he makes ripples through the lives of the people he holds dearest, until fate twists everything he thought he knew.

series.title: Wet Hot Boys
series.description: A scholarship swimmer who refuses to hide falls for the closeted golden boy he's built to beat. Between a scheming girlfriend and a ruthless father, loving in secret may cost them both everything.
